Subject: High latency and 503 bursts during Saturday midnight deploy (requesting SLA guidance)

Hi Evelyn,

We saw a sharp latency spike and intermittent 503s during our scheduled deploy on Saturday night (UTC 2029-07-05 05:45 - 06:20). Our checkout page experienced errors and elevated P95/P99 latency for about 27 minutes. This materially impacted checkout completion for ~2% of transactions.

Can you confirm whether this is eligible for an SLA credit and what evidence you need from us? I'm attaching a small slice of our edge logs and a Grafana screenshot. We're gathering full traces but wanted to flag this quickly because billing closes on the 7th.

Relevant timestamps from our side (UTC):
- First elevated latency: 2029-07-05T05:46:12Z
- Peak errors: 2029-07-05T06:03:10Z
- Error tail: 2029-07-05T06:13:40Z

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz

EdgeCommerce

Hi Marta — thanks for flagging and for the attachments.

Quick note on process: we need to verify the impact window and confirm the root cause (service-side versus customer traffic/queries) before we determine SLA credit eligibility. To speed this up could you also send:
- A sample request ID list (3-5 ids) that failed during the peak
- Any client-side retry/timeout configuration you used for that deploy (if custom)
- Whether you routed traffic through a custom routing policy for the deploy

I'll loop in Karthik and Marissa to start an internal evidence pull and correlate our side's telemetry. We aim to have an initial window verification within 24 hours. If you prefer a call I'm available after 1pm PT.

Best,
Evelyn Hart

Hi Marta — thanks again for the request ids and trace bundle. Our investigation team completed a correlation of your request ids with our ingress and inference traces. Summary below and next steps: 

Confirmed impact window (UTC): 2029-07-05T05:46:00Z — 2029-07-05T06:13:00Z (27 minutes)
Root cause: transient eviction on an autoscaling group in us-west-2 that caused a subset of inference workers to return 5xx responses while the autoscaler recovered. The eviction was triggered by an infrastructure-side storage throughput spike that is unrelated to customer traffic.
SLA determination: Eligible for a pro-rata service credit under the Availability section of the contract.
Estimated remedy: 10% service credit applied to July 2029 invoice on a pro-rata basis for the impacted region. Final credit amount will be calculated by finance after we verify the usage numbers for your account; we will confirm within 7 business days.

Requested next steps from EdgeCommerce: please confirm you accept the proposed remedy (reply to this thread) and confirm whether you want a public postmortem (high-level summary suitable for your internal stakeholders) or a full technical postmortem (detailed log bundles and timeline). We can also schedule a short review call with SRE and CS.

I'll open the formal SLA claim ticket (EC-3928) and tag finance to start the credit calc. Marissa / Karthik — I'll need the raw host bundle and eviction traces attached to the ticket so finance can associate usage.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
